blocks.text: Level B1 begins with a tool you will use throughout the rest of the course: a dictionary organised by root. In A2, you learnt that almost every Arabic word comes from a root and a pattern (A2-01), and you recognised the derived forms (A2-18). Now you will turn that knowledge into a method: when you encounter an unfamiliar word, even without vowel marks, you will break it down layer by layer, identify its root even if a letter has disappeared or changed, find it in the dictionary and choose the meaning that fits the context. This step will help you work independently with the authentic texts in module B1.3. Two weeks.
